name: Covariance Splat Reading
definition: A method to read a single 3D Gaussian Splat in covariance representation from two texture arrays, decoding its properties into a CovSplat struct.
summary: Covariance Splat Reading decodes a 3D Gaussian Splat from two GPU textures into a structure containing position, color, and covariance data, distinguishing itself by this specific texture-based retrieval method.
